preconditions.description: The number of stations must be between 1 and 100000.
The number of commuters must be between 1 and 100000.
The total units of Nitro must be between 0 and 10000000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= d_i <= 100 for d_i in distances)
preconditions.description: Each distance between stations must be between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= t_i <= 10000000 for t_i in arrival_times)
preconditions.description: Each commuter's arrival time must be between 0 and 10000000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= s_i < e_i <= n for s_i, e_i in destinations)
preconditions.description: Each commuter's boarding station must be less than their destination station.

postconditions.description: The output must be the minimal total travel time as a string.
